title: zotero-backup: backup and restore of Zotero libraries, keeping the item keys
description:
Back up and restore Zotero libraries (personal library and groups) through the Zotero web API, keeping the item keys, so restored items are the same items and citations in Word, LibreOffice and Google Docs keep working.

  • Complete backups: every backup is a dated folder with the whole library: items (with notes, annotations and the trash), collections, saved searches, library settings such as tag colours, the full-text index, and the attachment files.
  • Small and fast after the first run: unchanged files are hard links to the previous backup; old backups are pruned by day, week and month.
  • Restore into the same library, everything or selected items, with a preview first.
  • One executable for macOS, Windows and Linux (Go, standard library only); API keys in the system keychain.

Tested on macOS, including an end-to-end stress test against the Zotero API and Zotero desktop. Documentation: rkrug.github.io/zotero-backup.
